{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears only once, with their latest test
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the number of sites
print("Number of sites:", df['site'].nunique())
print("Sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Calculate response rate per site: proportion of patients who responded (responded == 1)
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rate_by_site = response_rate_by_site.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Display the response rates
response_rate_by_site"}
